milestones.title: Water ripples: ripple canvas above bg/below fg, background-only tap detection, theme-tinted concentric rings
milestones.note: Code complete + verified (42 tests, build green): pure ripples.ts model (createRipple 2-3 staggered rings, advance/radius/alpha/expiry, isBackgroundTap ignoring a/button/[data-no-ripple]) + RippleCanvas.tsx (z-0 between -z-10 bg and z-10 fg, pointer-events-none, window pointerdown listener, accent-tinted strokes via --accent, on-demand rAF loop that idles when no rings). Wired into App. Next: M3 themes (Matrix+Rainbow bgs, theme orb, crossfade, localStorage).

milestones.title: Themes: Matrix + Rainbow backgrounds, theme orb (bottom-right, idle bob), crossfade + orb pulse, accent var + rainbow scrim, localStorage persistence
milestones.note: Code complete + verified (full suite 83 tests, build green). Foundation: theme.ts + ThemeContext (hydrate/persist localStorage, mirrors data-theme + --accent/--accent-2), matrix.ts + MatrixBackground + RainbowBackground (CSS-only conic gradient). FINAL slice this run: BackgroundStage.tsx (renders bg by useTheme, crossfade via stacked layers + bg-crossfade-enter keyframe, GC's stale layer after 500ms, aria-hidden) wired into App; ThemeOrb.tsx (fixed bottom-right, accent conic skin, idle orb-bob, orb-pulse on click via animationend, theme-aware aria-label, accent focus-visible ring) wired into App; rainbow-scrim (dark radial overlay inside rainbow layer) + [data-theme='rainbow'] .link-card stronger frost; reduced-motion stills bob (keeps user-initiated pulse). All 3 bgs now switch live via orb. NEXT: M4 polish (reduced-motion toggle, cursor sprites/picker, hover tilt, tap glow, DPR hook, visibilitychange pause, full kbd a11y/tab order, safe-area insets, Playwright smoke).
